summary: The solution employs a solid set of models and feature engineering techniques, including TF-IDF and PyTorch Tabular ResNet, but suffers from severe logical flaws. A bug in column type detection causes all categorical features to be treated as text, neutralizing intended categorical encoding. Furthermore, the agent incorrectly implements target encoding (causing in-fold leakage), leaks validation statistics during imputation, and wastes compute by omitting two fully trained models from the final ensemble.
